title: Stream checksum header + per-endpoint sampling and function-call span shim for OpenAI adapter
author: Elena Mora
description: Motivation: high-volume streaming endpoints were producing large volumes of traces and occasional silent stream truncations when proxies or clients dropped frames. This PR adds three coordinated pieces: 1) per-endpoint sampling config (server-side) so high-throughput routes can be sampled at configurable rates; 2) an opt-in stream checksum header (X-RW-Stream-Checksum) added by the OpenAI compatibility adapter to enable end-to-end payload integrity checks across proxies and the client-side SDK; and 3) a lightweight function-call span shim that ties tool/function executions (including external tool invocations) to the parent request span while recording function latency, exit code/exception, and output size. The OpenAI adapter enrichment is backward-compatible: it only sets additional response headers and emits structured telemetry events; it does not alter user-visible response bodies. This change also introduces a small server-side cache of last-checksum-per-connection to detect repeated retransmits and improve logging signal. The description below lists what changed and why. Changes are split across runtime (sampling engine), api gateway (header plumbing), openai-compat adapter (shim), and tests.
commits: runtime: add per-endpoint sampling config and sampling decision cache
gateway: propagate X-RW-Stream-Checksum on streamed responses
openai-compat: attach function-call span shim and emit structured function_call telemetry
tests: add unit + integration tests for sampling and checksum mismatch handling
review_comments: Raj Patel: Please make sampling rate configurable via the console/route config; hardcoding in yaml is not sufficient for customers.
Sofia Nguyen: The checksum header name looks good; we should ensure SDKs expose an opt-in client verification path so users can verify end-to-end integrity.
Marco Alvarez: Can we avoid allocating on every streamed fragment? Suggest reusing a buffer in gateway/streaming_handler.go.
Author (Elena): Addressed Marco's buffer reuse comment, added a shared buffer pool; moved sampling to an atomic decision cache to avoid per-request map lookups.
Raj: Left a minor nit on log message verbosity; otherwise LGTM after docs update.
Sofia: Approved after confirming SDK follow-up ticket.
ci_checks: integration/streaming: flaky on first run -> rerun passed
release_notes: Added per-endpoint telemetry sampling and an opt-in stream checksum header (X-RW-Stream-Checksum). Function-call executions are now correlated to parent request spans and emit structured telemetry (latency, size, success). These features are opt-in via route config and the OpenAI compatibility adapter; see docs/observability/streaming.md for rollout and SDK follow-up notes.
